format: OSwind native membership format-floor qualification review v1
baseline: The actual frozen d665a30 engine uses 679 original inputs plus one test-only harness. It admits legacy native36, writes and caches a statement before the fence. Cached and ordinary writes refuse after the fence, but a fresh old engine admits completed format1 with pending replay. The corrected wrapper preserves the same frozen executable. Cleanup of all four owned accounts is asserted. The new source must refuse old-engine admission on format2 and after current erasure/renewal.
scope: New native36 handovers write state format2. Tests cover actual old36 positive admission, cached writer and fresh refusal; retention through cancellation/local erasure; supported helper downgrade refusal; legacy preparing/cancelling recovery; interrupted committed legacy applying upgrade with rejected SQL COMMIT and exact token/account preservation. Already-cleared format1 previews can finish replay but do not gain a retroactive cached-writer fence; a separate durable owned backfill is required before public integration. Public owner-add response/UI, revocation/rotation, remote client build negotiation, large/offline/provider retention, production DP-Keychain, live GUI, physical two-Mac/provider, energy, notarization and ranking acceptance remain open.
